works.description:
location: West 81st Street, New York City
Sketching decor ideas for our first post-grad apartment. At the time, Poppi was our drink of choice, and we would often stop by Westside Market to grab a few discounted cans.

location: West Village, New York City
I always imagined the Cellar Dog as a kind, relaxed dog. I've spent friends' birthdays, office outings, and late-night pit stops here, in addition to walking past it hundreds of times after exiting the Christopher Street station.

location: West Village, New York City
Long walks in the West Village during lunch are a dream—you have room to see the shape of the neighborhood: trees, people, and cats.

location: Mayfield Road, Ohio
Some practice while watching Bollywood movies at home.

location: Murray Hill, New York City
Taking the bus down to the Morgan Library. A friend from high school was in town; he told us that he had walked from LaGuardia to our friend's place in Williamsburg.

location: American Museum of Natural History, New York City
Potentially my favorite place in the world. This was from an afternoon in the Hall of North American Mammals.

location: Central Park, New York City
Aud sitting in Central Park, alongside a sketch of my grandmother when she was younger.

location: East Village, New York City
Drawn sitting at Coffee Project in the East Village, after getting a haircut with Lyudmilla by Tompkins Square Park.

location: Bushwick, Brooklyn
One of my best friends was visiting New York City from San Francisco, and she had scheduled a tattoo appointment with her favorite artist. It turned out beautifully.

location: American Museum of Natural History, New York City
Drawn after a visit to the insect section of the Gilder Center.

location: Moynihan Train Hall, New York City
I have spent many hours people-watching in Moynihan, waiting for the Northeast Regional to whisk me down to Charm City.

location: Bed Stuy, Brooklyn
A woman with an embroidered shirt on the subway to Brooklyn.
